headline_marked: First [[uranium consignment arrives]] in Dhaka for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant
headline: First uranium consignment arrives in Dhaka for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant
summary: The first cargo plane from Russia arrived on Friday night, marking a critical milestone for the power plant's Unit-2.
details: The first cargo plane carrying nuclear fuel for the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant arrived at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka from Russia on Friday night.
The flight landed at approximately 11:44 pm under international security guidelines, after which unloading operations began immediately.
The Bangladesh Army will transport the nuclear fuel to the project site in Rooppur under special security arrangements.
Golam Mahbub, chief of administration of the plant, stated that a total of nine flights are expected to deliver over 200 assembled fuel elements by December.
This shipment includes 163 assemblies specifically for Unit-2 of the power plant.
Highway police have been instructed to ensure a clear lane and smooth transportation of the uranium convoy to the project site.
The arrival of this first batch of nuclear fuel for Unit-2 had been previously postponed on September 24 due to airspace clearance issues.
caption:
Bangladesh's first nuclear fuel has landed. A cargo plane from Russia just delivered the uranium for the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant.

The first cargo plane carrying nuclear fuel for the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant arrived at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka from Russia on Friday night.

The flight landed at approximately 11:44 pm under international security guidelines, after which unloading operations began immediately.

The Bangladesh Army will transport the nuclear fuel to the project site in Rooppur under special security arrangements.

Golam Mahbub, chief of administration of the plant, stated that a total of nine flights are expected to deliver over 200 assembled fuel elements by December.

This shipment includes 163 assemblies specifically for Unit-2 of the power plant.

Highway police have been instructed to ensure a clear lane and smooth transportation of the uranium convoy to the project site.

The arrival of this first batch of nuclear fuel for Unit-2 had been previously postponed on September 24 due to airspace clearance issues.

Source: Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, bdnews24.com

headline: Mirpur 10: Hawkers evicted from footpaths, roads now clear
summary: A major drive to remove illegal street vendors has transformed the landscape of Mirpur 10's Section C, Avenue-2, leaving the sidewalks empty.
details: The sidewalks and roads of Avenue-2 in Section C, Mirpur 10, have been cleared of hawkers and mobile vendors following a recent enforcement drive.
The operation, which took place last Wednesday, has significantly changed the appearance of the area, removing long-standing street markets like the Hope Market.
Commuters and pedestrians now find the footpaths empty and accessible, a stark contrast to the以前 long-standing congestion caused by street vendors.
The drive aims to reclaim public spaces for pedestrians and reduce traffic congestion on the main roads of the Mirpur area.
